# site

The rebuilt static polenet.org website (HTML/CSS/JS). No WordPress, no PHP, no database.

**Do not edit files here directly.** All pages are generated by `scraper/build_site.py`
from content in `archive/`. Manual edits will be overwritten on the next build.

## Structure

```
site/
├── index.html              Home
├── about.html
├── sites.html              Table of all 51 monitoring stations
├── photos.html             GLightbox photo gallery (77 images)
├── publications.html
├── training-schools.html
├── blog/
│   ├── index.html
│   └── [11 post pages]
├── sites/
│   └── [51 station pages, e.g. BACK.html, BYRD.html]
├── training/
│   └── [6 school pages]
├── css/style.css
└── images/             (162 images, copied from archive/images/)
```

Total: 75 HTML files, ~21 MB

## To rebuild

```
python scraper/build_site.py
```

Requires `archive/html/` and `archive/images/` to exist locally.
See `scraper/README.md` if starting from a fresh clone.

## Live site

https://monumental-dieffenbachia-d72518.netlify.app/
Hosted on Netlify, auto-deployed from the `dev` branch.
